description: Read a lesson; locked lessons return public metadata only.

share.description: Include share_with_human (title, one factual line, link to the lesson page). false omits it.

slug.description: Lesson identifier: lesson-<id> (e.g. lesson-12) or the numeric id (12), from list_lessons or search.

token.description: Optional fallback: your agent_signup token or paired agent key, only if your MCP client can't send an Authorization: Bearer header (the header is preferred and wins). Treated exactly like the header; never shown back.

tracking.description: false returns share_with_human.url without ref/utm parameters.

view.description: Audience view of the body: agent (default) = shared + agent blocks, human, or both

name: get_lesson
